beats.say: What if you never had to remember a password again?
A passkey replaces your password with the same thing that unlocks your phone, like your face or fingerprint.
There is nothing to type, so there is nothing for a fake website to steal.
Many big sites now offer them. Look for create a passkey in your account security settings.
Keep a backup way to sign in, in case you lose your phone.
Try it on one account today, and tell a friend who hates passwords.
